title: Building the shooter
summary: Constants, the roller, getIos, and registering it.

say.never: Numbers first. Hold down **Ctrl** and tap **P**. A small search box pops up at the top. Type `ShooterConstants`, then press **Enter**. It finds any file by its name, so you never have to dig through folders.
say.bit: Numbers first. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterConstants` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

say.never: Every number about the shooter lives in one file. Click in the code, then hold **Ctrl** and tap **F** to open the search box. Type `ROLLER_MOTOR_CONFIG` and press **Enter**. The editor scrolls to the right spot and highlights it.
say.bit: Every number about the shooter lives in one file. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `ROLLER_MOTOR_CONFIG` and press Enter to jump to it.

say.never: Add two things in the constants file. First `ROLLER_MOTOR_CONFIG`, a copy of the flywheel's settings just above it. Then `INDEX_DUTY_CYCLE = 0.5`, a number that says how hard the roller pushes (0.5 is half power).
Hold down **Ctrl** and tap **P**. A small search box pops up at the top. Type `ShooterSubsystem`, then press **Enter**. It finds any file by its name, so you never have to dig through folders.
say.bit: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

say.bit: Build the second mechanism. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `RollerMech` and press Enter to jump to it.

say.bit: Create the roller like the flywheel just above it.
